_comment: Cursor permissions.json — deploy to ~/.cursor/permissions.json. Controls auto-run behavior for terminal commands and MCP tools.

allow_instructions: Read-only git inspection commands (git status, git diff, git log) are safe to run automatically.
Lint and type-check commands that only read files and report errors are safe.
block_instructions: Hold all file write, delete, or overwrite operations for my review.
Hold all network requests that are not to approved package registries.
Hold all privilege escalation attempts (sudo, su) for review.
Hold any operation that modifies shell config files (.bashrc, .zshrc, .profile).
